item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini padma ka ra varm-a kiged yekede dokiyalduγuluγči kelemürči ayaq-γ-a tegimlig sayin erdeni orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orčiγulbai

hindkeg-ün ubadini badm-a ka-a ra karm-a kiged yekede tokiyalduγuluγči / kelemürči ayaγ-<qa>-a tegimlig sayin erdeni orčiγuluγad, nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai, [Three lines in Sanskrit], öglige-yin eǰen amuγulang ǰirγalang büritügei, manggalam. erkeü tegünčilen iregsen darqan / lam-a-yin suu-tur sitüǰü, sasin oyutu sayin-i bariγči mergen günding güši orčiγulbai. , .
